requirements.text: A UML model element may be of different kinds
A UML model has primitive datatypes
An attribute belongs to a single class
A Package is composed of any number (or none) of PackageElement.
A PackageElement references its parent Package.
A UML model has classifiers and attributes. Each classifier may have attributes that are their opposite type
A UML model has classes which are composed of attributes
A UML model has classes. These classes may have other classes associated that act as their general opposite
A UML model has classes which may have forward associations
A UML model has associations. Each Association has a source, which is a class
